tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool, blue-biased off-white in Manual; the deep navy of a text-mode setup screen in Setup screen.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Dialog panels that float over paper: TableOfContents and anything else framed with border-frame and shadow-dialog.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells, such as code samples of the markdown entry format.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines that carry no meaning: the line under a GenreSection head, the run-out after a SubgroupLabel. Below 3:1 by design; never use it for a control edge.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning, at least 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken in both themes: LineageTag borders, port-tree lines in nested EntryLists, ToC leader dots, the FamilyHeading double rule.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, descriptions, game titles without a homepage, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken (15:1 or more in both themes). Also the PageHeader double rule and the TableOfContents frame.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on all three papers (6.3:1 or more): genre counts, SubgroupLabel, the brackets of a SourceLink, the kind label of an EngineTag, forge hosts.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: The game side of an entry: a title that links to the game's own site, PageHeader links. On all three papers (10.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark). Never on highlight in Setup screen (2.1:1).

tokens.name: source
tokens.usage: The code side of an entry: the word inside every [source] link. On all three papers (5.2:1 or more light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The selection bar of a text-mode menu: the current item in TableOfContents, a search match. A fill only; text on it is on-highlight.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight fill (17:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, square. 10.8:1 or more on every paper in both themes.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The color of the hard dialog shadow (shadow-dialog) and of the cover's shadow block. Not for text.

tokens.name: ega-blue
tokens.usage: EGA palette index 1, the blue of DOS setup screens. Identity color: the play ink in Manual, the large block on the cover. As text only through play.

tokens.name: ega-cyan
tokens.usage: EGA palette index 3. Identity color for the cover and illustrations. Fails as text on Manual paper (2.6:1); never use it for text there.

tokens.name: ega-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: EGA palette index 11. The source ink in Setup screen. Fails as text on light paper; reach it only through source.

tokens.name: ega-yellow
tokens.usage: EGA palette index 14, the highlight bar of a text-mode menu. Fill only, through highlight and focus; it vanishes on Manual paper (1.03:1), so set it on ega-blue or ink there.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at font-stretch 125%: the wide grotesque of a 1990s PC game box. Hosted on Google Fonts with its wdth axis (62 to 125).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: PageHeader only, once per page, with font-stretch 125%. Sentence case, exactly as the list writes it.

styles.name: genre
styles.usage: GenreSection headings (the list's H2), with font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: family
styles.usage: FamilyHeading (the list's italic H3): an engine, studio or series that groups entries inside a genre.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo at its normal width for reading.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: The bold game title that opens every Entry, in play when it links to a homepage, in ink when it has none.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An open source simulation game based upon Transport Tycoon Deluxe.
styles.usage: Entry descriptions, the PageHeader intro. Keep lines near 68ch (the measure token).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A free kart racing game. It focuses on fun and not on realistic kart physics.
styles.usage: Descriptions inside a nested EntryList (the ports under an original game).

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono: the code side of the list, and a nod to the IBM PC these games first ran on.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: SubgroupLabel, LineageTag, the EngineTag kind, the TableOfContents title. Set text-transform: uppercase; write the words in their normal case.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: SourceLink, EngineTag names, genre counts. Use tabular figures wherever counts line up.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Markdown samples of the entry format, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a bracket and the word in a SourceLink run; LineageTag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items in an Entry's meta row; the dialog-shadow offset on the cover.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between entries in a nested EntryList.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between top-level entries; panel padding; the minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Indent of a nested EntryList (the port-tree branch); TableOfContents padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a FamilyHeading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between GenreSections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: panels, focus rings, highlight bars. The system is square, like a text-mode cell grid.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: LineageTag only, so a tag reads as a printed label rather than a cell.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: The hard, unblurred drop shadow of a text-mode dialog. Only on panels framed with border-frame (TableOfContents). Never on entries or tags.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Pair with rule or rule-strong: border: var(--border-hairline) var(--rule).

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: The double line of a DOS dialog frame. Pair with ink for PageHeader and TableOfContents, with rule-strong for FamilyHeading.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for descriptions and the PageHeader intro.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column; the list is one column at every width.
